# Bundled Lucide icon

`mouse-pointer-2.mjs` contains the path from Lucide **0.468.0**, with its viewBox
and a cursor hotspot. It is rendered with SVG DOM APIs rather than HTML strings.
The fill/outline are set by `../../cursor-theme.mjs`.

Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/blob/0.468.0/icons/mouse-pointer-2.svg
License: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/blob/0.468.0/LICENSE

Bundling the one icon keeps the extension offline, compatible with MV3 CSP, and
free of npm runtime dependencies. Retain the accompanying `LICENSE` when redistributing.
